_about: How heavy common ingredients are, so cups and spoons can be converted to grams (Metric view) and grams to cups (US view). gPerMl = grams per millilitre, from standard Australian kitchen tables (e.g. 1 cup plain flour = 150 g). liquid = shown in ml, not grams. Names must match the ingredient's 'item' exactly (lowercase). A recipe can also give its own value with gPerMl on the ingredient line. These are approximate: weighing once and adding your own value is always better.
